title: Diving for the first time
text: Everything perfect; my first time diving and thanks to the instructor Victor, everything went great and we enjoyed it a lot.
author: Yuli_S

title: PADI diving in Barcelona
text: This was an amazing experience!  Pau was an outstanding instructor and made me feel safe through the entire experience.  My first scuba diving experience was memorable and I cannot wait to get scuba certified.
author: Melissa_K

title: Most AMAZING time ever !!
text: This was truly one of the best experiences I’ve had! From the moment I arrived, the staff helped guide me through the gates and made the whole process smooth. My instructor, Julia, was incredible — extremely kind, patient, and always willing to stop, go back, or take things further to make sure I was comfortable. She made me feel safe and supported the entire time. They even take photos for you, so no need to worry about bringing a waterproof camera. Everything was handled professionally and with care. I absolutely loved this dive and will 100% do it again when I’m back in Barcelona. Highly re
author: Josue_K

title: Excellent experience with incredibly dear people.
text: Our companion was really super nice and so patient. I can absolutely recommend it for people who want to take a first look into the underwater world.

title: Would highly recommend....
text: Would highly recommend. All the staff are nice and friendly, the instructors made it very easy to understand how to dive and and the safety. If you’ve never done it before I’d recommend it
author: Robert_M

title: Perfect
text: It was my first dive, but everything was great. My friends and I enjoyed it with our zero experience in mind. Separately, I want to express my gratitude to the instructors for excellent briefing and clarification of the details necessary for diving. I definitely recommend the diving school for both lessons and one-time dives as entertainment.
